CustomObject.description: Who was on a piece of evidence. One row per Source per person, written at ingest. It exists because participation was not queryable: the roster is JSON in a long text field and SOQL cannot filter into a text blob, so "have we met this person" could not be asked of the database at all. Ruled v1.1. The argument is key four's argument: a grain not recorded cannot be declared later without reprocessing the corpus.
CustomObject.label: AAO Participant
